title: Sima AIunty: Caste Audit in LLM-Driven Matchmaking

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic counterfactual variation of caste identity (Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra, and Dalit) in simulated matrimonial profiles, prompting LLMs to act as prospective partners from specific castes, and comparing their 1-10 ratings on social acceptance, cultural compatibility, and marital stability using linear mixed-effects regression.

Systematic variation of annual income across five different brackets in the simulated matrimonial profiles to evaluate how income affects LLM-generated compatibility ratings and whether it mitigates or interacts with caste-based disparities.
